feat(camellia): migrate template and specification routes

Summary:
- add DAM-25 route definitions, navigation groups, and hidden template
  manage subpages for detail, preview, and editor flows
- introduce shared route metadata and fallback-capable request helpers for
  template, classification, specification, and size-range resources
- implement first-pass camellia pages for template classification/manage and
  specification template/size-range/classification views

Rationale:
- DAM-25 needs a migration-ready information architecture before deeper CRUD
  and canvas interactions can land safely
- keeping legacy path, permission, and endpoint metadata in one catalog makes
  shell integration and later backend hookup easier to review and extend
- fallback fixtures let the new pages stay usable without blocking on auth or
  incomplete backend contracts during the first migration pass

Tests:
- pnpm typecheck:camellia
- pnpm build:camellia
